summary: Galaxy Gaming, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 21, 2026, reporting that Evolution Malta Holding Limited terminated the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated July 18, 2024, as amended, under which Evolution would acquire Galaxy. The termination is effective immediately, and Evolution must pay Galaxy a termination fee of $5,234,678 within two business days. The terms were previously disclosed in Galaxy's July 18, 2024 8-K. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned in this filing. The transaction was structured as a merger with a wholly owned subsidiary of Evolution. Watch for receipt of the termination fee and any potential alternative strategic transactions for Galaxy.
